title: Questions before starting a project with us.

items.question: What does {company} do?
items.answer: {company} is a creative production studio in Malaysia. We produce podcasts, videos and photography, and handle graphic design, websites, digital marketing and branding. Podcasts are our speciality.

items.question: Can you handle several services in one project?
items.answer: Yes. Many clients combine services, for example a podcast with short clips, event photography and social media posts, or a new brand identity with a website. One team handles all of it, so everything stays consistent.

items.question: Do I need a studio to produce a podcast or video?
items.answer: No. We record at your office, venue or event, remotely, or in a location we arrange for you, anywhere in Malaysia.

items.question: Do you work with government agencies and corporate clients?
items.answer: Yes. {company} is registered with MOF and works with government bodies, corporate teams, SMEs, brands and creators across Malaysia.

items.question: Do you produce video podcasts and short clips?
items.answer: Yes. We record video podcasts on multiple cameras and edit them into full episodes plus short clips for Instagram, TikTok, YouTube and LinkedIn.

items.question: Can you build or redesign our website?
items.answer: Yes. We build fast, mobile-friendly websites and landing pages, and can produce the photos, videos and copy that go on them.

items.question: Can you manage our social media and marketing?
items.answer: Yes. We plan content, manage social media and run ad campaigns, using the videos, photos and designs we produce for you.

items.question: How do I book a consultation?
items.answer: Use the consultation form on this website or contact {company} through WhatsApp. Tell us what you need and the team will respond with the right next step.
